events.title: Full Moon Cacao Ceremony at Pyramids of Chi
events.venue_address: Jl. Raya Tegallalang, Tegallalang, Ubud, Bali
events.short_description: Full moon cacao ceremony inside the Pyramid of the Sun with sound healing (Tibetan singing bowls) and a 3-course vegan dinner. A monthly community gathering aligned to the August 28 Sturgeon Moon.
events.description: Join Pyramids of Chi for their monthly Full Moon Cacao Ceremony on August 28, the night of the Sturgeon Moon (partial lunar eclipse). The evening opens with a sacred cacao ceremony, followed by a deep sound healing session inside the Pyramid of the Sun using Tibetan singing bowls, before closing with a 3-course vegan dinner. A grounded, community-centred full moon ritual at one of Ubud's most acoustically and energetically distinct venues.
events._curatorNote: Per-edition slug full-moon-cacao-ceremony-august active on both megatix.co.id and megatix.com.au. Aug 28 = confirmed full moon (Sturgeon Moon + partial lunar eclipse). Ingested 10 days before moon consistent with Jul 20 precedent for Jul 29 moon (full-moon-ceremony-july). Watch window was ~Aug 20 but two per-edition slugs on two TLDs is stronger signal than July.
